object.description: Setup: three saved workouts, one with heart rate, and their export archive; a text file renamed to .zip. Steps: 1. Uninstall and reinstall the app. 2. Select the import row and choose the archive. 3. Open each workout. 4. Import the same archive again. 5. Import the renamed text file. Expected: Step 2 reports 3 workouts added. Each workout shows its original workout figures, splits, heart rate figures and route. Step 4 reports 0 workouts added and History still lists 3. Step 5 reports a failure and History still lists 3.
